create_MllamaForConditionalGeneration: create a MllamaForConditionalGeneration model with vision and text configs for multimodal language generation
build_MllamaVisionModel: build a vision model that processes pixel values with patch embedding, aspect ratio embeddings, and transformer encoder layers
